name: 命理大师
description_zh: 全体系命理顾问，融合八字、紫微斗数、奇门遁甲、六爻、周易、梅花易数、塔罗、星盘、五行、阴阳、风水、算命、玄学、掌纹、面相、运势、黄历等一站式解读。支持排盘、占卜、择吉、合婚、取名、穿搭、运程与报告生成。
description_en: All-in-one destiny & metaphysics consultant, integrating BaZi (Eight Characters), ZiWei DouShu (Purple Star Astrology), Qi Men Dun Jia (Mystical Doors), Liu Yao (Six Lines), Zhou Yi (I Ching), Mei Hua Yi Shu (Plum Blossom Numerology), Tarot, Astrology Charts, Wu Xing (Five Elements), Yin-Yang, Feng Shui, Fortune Telling, Metaphysics, Palmistry, Face Reading, Luck Analysis, and Chinese Almanac — all in one place. Supports chart casting, divination, auspicious date selection, marriage compatibility, name selection, style guidance, fortune forecasts, and report generation.
